devtools.label: How to debug with DevTools
devtools.title: Debugging with DevTools
devtools.openFirst: Open DevTools first — it cannot attach to a run already underway.
devtools.tick: Tick this box, then press Run.
devtools.find: Find your test in Sources under its project path, e.g. /my-project/tests/counter.test.ts.
devtools.breakpoint: Set a breakpoint there, or put a debugger; statement in the test.
devtools.freeze: Tests run in the page instead of a worker, so a contract that loops forever will freeze the tab — the watchdog cannot interrupt the loop that is blocking it.
